name: Phiewer
price: Phiewer (lite) free; Phiewer PRO $7.99 one-time (Mac App Store)
engine: native (AVFoundation for video, LibRaw for RAW)
summary: Fast keyboard-friendly media viewer for folders of photos, RAW, videos and audio. PRO adds Showcases (virtual albums), duplicate finder, compare view, non-destructive editing, Finder tags and custom shortcuts for a low one-time price.
where_it_wins: Duplicate finder and compare view of up to 9 images
Showcases: saved virtual albums across folders
Finder tags and comments, search by tags/EXIF/date
Image editing (crop, filters, resize) in PRO
where_schnellbild_wins: Free and open source, no PRO tier
MKV, WebM and other formats via VLC
Dual pane with Norton Commander keys
View-only auto enhance for photos and videos

free.note: lite free (browse, all formats, simple slideshow, EXIF); everything else PRO, $7.99 one-time

native_apple_silicon.note: universal since 5.0.1, fully native rewrite in 6

no_account_no_tracking.note: no account, no ads; App Store privacy label: analytics (device ID, product interaction), not linked to you

dark_light_setting.note: Store lists 'Dark Interface' (follows dark mode); an in-app light/dark switch is neither listed in the store, the site nor among the Settings → Shortcuts actions. Searched: phiewer.com, support FAQ, App Store page and version history.

languages_20.note: 8: EN, DE, FR, ES, PT, IT, NL, PL

thumbnail_grid.note: Exposé, Pinboard, Grid; folders can be shown between files (7.1)

recursive_search.note: search by name, tags, comments, date, EXIF (PRO); option to include subfolders in the current view (7.1)

network_shares_fast.note: NAS and external drives listed; prefetching; fix for reloads on network drives (6.3)

multiple_windows.note: The full action list (Settings → Shortcuts) has 'Show main window' but no New Window; site and store describe one main window.

img_modern_formats.note: HEIC, AVIF, WebP yes; JPEG XL not listed

img_animated.note: GIF and animated WebP; APNG not listed

slideshow.note: lite: simple slideshow; PRO: animations, intervals, loop

slideshow_recursive.note: PRO only; subfolders and global random shuffle; videos play in it (auto-mute option)

auto_enhance_view.note: PRO: filters and adjustments 'without changing the original' with undo history; it is editing, not an auto-enhance view

file_info_exif.note: EXIF and file info; codec/bitrate not listed

wrong_extension_note.note: detects images with a wrong extension and opens them (6.5); no note to the user documented

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: AVI, MPG, 3GP, MTS, M2TS, TS listed; MKV, WebM, WMV, FLV not in the current format list

video_skim_arrows.note: configurable skip interval (PRO video controls); arrow-key skimming not documented

subtitles_embedded.note: Video controls listed: speed, skip interval, loop, volume; no subtitle action in the full shortcut list or in the store's version history.

subtitles_external_files.note: No subtitle support in site, store or the full shortcut list.

audio_track_choice.note: No audio track action in the full shortcut list; video controls listed on the site are speed, skip, loop.

control_bar_movable.note: Not described on phiewer.com, the support page or the App Store page.

playlist.note: PRO Showcases: virtual collections 'like playlists' across folders

pip.note: No Picture in Picture in site, store version history or the full shortcut list (only 'Always On Top').

music_mode.note: MP3, M4A, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, AAC, CAF, AC3

streaming_urls.note: Opens files and folders only (File → Open …); no URL or stream feature in site or store.

video_filters_enhance.note: Filters and adjustments are described for images only; videos got zoom and a volume control (6.5).

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: a user review asks for Quick Look integration

archives_as_folders.note: no archive format in the format list

manga_two_page.note: Gallery modes are Exposé, Pinboard, Grid and a compare view (hold C); no reading mode.

move_copy.note: drag and drop like Finder, ⌥ copy, spring-loading (8)

dual_pane.note: no pane feature on site or changelog; Schnellbild README comparison (from use) says no

undo_file_actions.note: ⌘Z for drag-and-drop moves (8); undo for rename/trash not stated

image_editing.note: PRO: QuickEdit crop, rotate, flip, resize, compression, filters

batch_convert.note: PRO: multi-export and batch compression; no batch rename documented

library_catalog.note: Finder tags and comments, favorites, Showcases; no catalog database

cloud_sync.note: PRO: share via macOS share sheet; no sync

keyboard_first.note: all actions can get shortcuts; single keys without modifiers (6.5)

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: all shortcuts listed in Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts; no printable sheet

boss_key.note: No hide-all action in the full shortcut list; Theater Mode only dims the desktop.

notarized_attested.note: Apple-signed via the App Store; closed source

mac_app_store.note: Phiewer (lite) id1226444549 and Phiewer PRO id1270923434
